Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 103. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have a mind that can track time, direction, and
detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following
benefits.
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum
of your current Ability Score Maximum.
You always know which way is north.
You always know the number of hours left before the
next sunrise or sunset.
You can accurately recall anything you have seen or
heard within the past month.
